name: contextwatch
description: Live prompt-cache and context telemetry for Claude Code.

askWhenCold.title: Ask before sending into a cold cache
askWhenCold.description: When the cache is cold and the context is large, ask whether to send anyway, compact first, or start fresh.

confirmSwitchUsd.title: Confirm model switches above (USD)
confirmSwitchUsd.description: Ask before a model switch that would rewrite a warm cache for more than this many dollars. 0 turns it off.

awayReminder.title: Remind me before the cache cools
awayReminder.description: Send one notification shortly before the cache lapses.

awayReminderMinutes.title: Reminder lead time (minutes)
awayReminderMinutes.description: How many minutes before the cache lapses the reminder is sent.
